meta.name: ChefFlow feature registry
meta.definition: A feature is recurring FUNCTIONALITY, tracked separately from the visual components that render it. A registry entry says: does it exist, where is the established implementation, and under what conditions should a new surface adopt it.
meta.rule: Not every feature belongs in every project. Read `selectWhen` first. If the condition applies, reuse the `canonical` implementation. Never build a second one.

features.name: Authentication and account states
features.library: next-auth v5 beta + @auth/drizzle-adapter, Google OAuth, MFA route
features.selectWhen: Any surface that shows data belonging to a specific account.
rules: Defence in depth: middleware, then the group layout requireX() guard, then a server-action auth gate. All three.
The UI is not a security boundary. Hiding nav or a button protects nothing.
Account states to design for: signed out, signed in, wrong role, expired session, MFA required, deletion pending, test account.

features.name: Search
features.library: custom server actions plus useDebounce. No cmdk.
features.selectWhen: More than roughly 20 records of one kind, or the user needs to jump between areas.
rules: Debounce. Show recents when the query is empty. Never block the UI while searching.

features.name: Filtering and sorting
features.selectWhen: Any list over roughly 20 items or with more than one meaningful dimension.
rules: Filter state lives in the URL. Show active filters as removable pills with a clear-all. Empty results get an EmptyState that explains which filter caused it.
features.note: @tanstack/react-table and react-virtual are installed but no .tsx imports react-table. Tables are hand-rolled and sorting is per-query. There is no shared sort hook; that is an open gap.

features.name: Forms and validation
canonical: server actions as the default submit path
features.library: zod v4; react-hook-form only in 3 large forms
features.selectWhen: Always, for any input.
rules: Validate inline as the user types, not only on submit.
An error message names what to do, not just what is wrong.
Never show success without server confirmation. Optimistic updates need try/catch with rollback and a failure toast.
Long forms save a draft and warn on unsaved navigation.
Maximum 7 fields per visible section; chunk the rest into collapsible groups.

features.name: Booking
features.selectWhen: The product takes appointments or events.
rules: Capacity Is Inventory: an unclassified date is never offered as Available.
No custom work before a survey or a direct call.

features.name: Payments
features.selectWhen: Money moves.
rules: Never render a locked or disabled paid button. The free path always executes and the upgrade prompt follows the completed action.
Never hide pricing.

features.name: File uploads
canonical: lib/storage/index.ts (local FS, sanitised paths, signed URLs)
features.selectWhen: Users supply files.
rules: Show per-file progress, accepted types and the size limit before the picker opens.
A failed upload keeps the file selected and offers retry.
react-dropzone is installed with zero importers; either use it or drop the dependency.

features.name: Galleries and media playback
canonical: components/photos/portfolio-gallery.tsx (10 competing implementations, see components.json gallery entry)
features.selectWhen: Images or video are the content.
rules: Fixed aspect-ratio containers so nothing shifts on load.
Video needs a poster frame and captions.
Lightbox is a dialog: focus trap, Escape, arrow keys.

features.name: Sharing
features.selectWhen: Something is shown to someone without an account.
rules: A guest surface is noindex when it carries personal data.
Token-addressed pages state clearly what the recipient can and cannot do.

features.name: Notifications (push, in-app, toast)
features.selectWhen: Something happens while the user is not looking at it.
rules: Never more than 2 toasts at once. 3s confirmation, 5s warning, errors do not auto-dismiss.
Push asks permission in context, after the value is obvious, never on first load.

features.name: User preferences and theming
features.library: next-themes, class attribute, storageKey chefflow-theme, light default, system disabled
features.selectWhen: Always, for theme. Palette swapping when the product is white-labelled or personal.
rules: PaletteScript is inlined in <head> so there is no flash.
Pinned by tests/unit/theme-and-color-guards.test.ts: do not change defaultTheme, enableSystem, storageKey or add forcedTheme without updating that test deliberately.

features.name: Analytics
features.library: posthog-js, Meta Pixel, recharts for display
features.selectWhen: There is a funnel worth measuring.
rules: PostHog init is gated behind consent.
Use TrackedLink rather than adding a click handler to a plain anchor.

features.name: Consent and privacy controls
features.selectWhen: Any analytics, tracking or third-party AI processing.
rules: Decline-by-default for non-essential cookies.
The consent banner never blocks the primary content of the page.

features.name: SEO metadata
features.selectWhen: The page is public.
rules: Every public route uses buildMarketingMetadata. Never hand-write a metadata object.
Canonical URL on every public page.

features.name: Structured data (JSON-LD)
canonical: components/seo/json-ld.tsx: JsonLd, OrganizationJsonLd, SoftwareApplicationJsonLd, FAQPageJsonLd, WebSiteJsonLd, BreadcrumbJsonLd, PersonJsonLd
features.selectWhen: A public page maps to a schema.org type.
rules: Reuse the exported helpers. Do not hand-write a script tag.

features.name: Open Graph previews
features.selectWhen: The page will be shared.
rules: Exactly 1200x630. Runtime edge. Inline styles are required by satori and are sanctioned only here.

features.name: Error recovery
features.selectWhen: Always.
rules: Every independently-loading region is inside a WidgetErrorBoundary.
Chunk load errors get the reload path, not the generic error card.
Show a copyable error id so a user can report it.

features.name: Offline and reconnection
features.library: hand-rolled service worker plus IndexedDB. No Workbox.
features.selectWhen: The product is used away from reliable connectivity. For a chef in a client kitchen, that is always.
rules: A queued action shows as queued, never as saved.
The offline banner is persistent, not a toast.
public/offline.html cannot import the design system, so its inline styles must be kept in sync with the tokens by hand.

features.name: Permission and role states
features.selectWhen: More than one kind of user.
rules: Design the denied state, not just the allowed one. Say what is missing and who can grant it.
Never a lock icon on a disabled button as the only explanation.

features.name: Admin tools
features.selectWhen: There is an operator behind the product.

features.name: Internationalisation
features.library: next-intl v4 is installed with zero imports; no messages/ or locales/ directory; <html lang="en"> is hardcoded.
features.selectWhen: A second locale is actually planned.
rules: Do not scatter t() calls in anticipation. Adopting i18n is a project, not a habit.
date-fns and lib/hooks/use-format.ts already handle locale-ish formatting; use those.
If i18n is never adopted, remove the unused dependency.

features.name: Installable app
features.selectWhen: The product is used on a phone repeatedly.
features.knownDefect: manifest.json points at /screenshots/mobile.png and /screenshots/desktop.png; neither exists, so Chrome drops the richer install UI. Maskable icons have no safe zone.

unusedDependencies.action: Remove. All animation is CSS keyframes plus Tailwind utilities, which is the better default anyway.
Remove until i18n is actually planned.
Either adopt it in the upload flow or remove it.
Tables are hand-rolled. Adopt it when a table needs real sorting and virtualisation, or remove it.
Migrate the 53 files to '@/components/ui/icons' and remove. Two icon libraries currently ship to the client.
